description: This file contains helper functions, type definitions, and export functions related to gateway status, configuration summaries, target resolution, and probe handling within the openclaw project. It manages gateway target resolution, configuration extraction, and probe result interpretation.

classes.name: GatewayStatusTarget
classes.description: Type representing a gateway status target, including its id, kind, URL, activity status, and optional SSH tunnel details.

classes.name: GatewayConfigSummary
classes.description: Type representing a summary of the gateway configuration, including path, existence, validity, issues, gateway settings, and discovery info.

methods.name: parseIntOrNull
methods.description: Parses a value into an integer or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: parseTimeoutMs
methods.description: Parses a raw timeout value into milliseconds, with fallback.

methods.name: normalizeWsUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a WebSocket URL string, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveTargets
methods.description: Resolves gateway targets based on configuration and optional explicit URL.

methods.name: isLoopbackProbeTarget
methods.description: Determines if a target is a loopback probe target based on its kind and URL.

methods.name: resolveProbeBudgetMs
methods.description: Calculates probe timeout budget based on target type and overall milliseconds.

methods.name: sanitizeSshTarget
methods.description: Sanitizes SSH target string by trimming and removing 'ssh' prefix.

methods.name: resolveAuthForTarget
methods.description: Resolves authentication tokens and passwords for a target, considering overrides and environment.

methods.name: extractConfigSummary
methods.description: Extracts and constructs a GatewayConfigSummary from a snapshot object.

methods.name: buildNetworkHints
methods.description: Builds network hint URLs based on configuration and network discovery.

methods.name: renderTargetHeader
methods.description: Renders a header string for a gateway target, with optional rich formatting.

methods.name: isScopeLimitedProbeFailure
methods.description: Checks if a probe failure is due to a missing scope.

methods.name: isProbeReachable
methods.description: Determines if a probe is considered reachable based on its result.

methods.name: renderProbeSummaryLine
methods.description: Generates a summary line for a probe result with optional rich formatting.
